title: The Lyra Technique II: SVD Denoising and Directional Projection
subtitle: Two new measurement channels extend KV-cache geometry to emotion and persona detection
abstract: W_K directional projection classifies 30 emotions at 12.3x chance (AUROC 0.992 valence) and injection into neutral text confirms model state, not text encoding. SVD denoising appears to reveal hidden signal, raising persona intensity from AUROC 0.611-0.751 to 0.899-0.992; however, the denoising deltas fall within the max-over-rank selection envelope (0/16 exceed it), so the raw AUROCs are the defensible numbers and the denoised values are reported as upper bounds pending nested CV. Dominant singular values carry scale; residual values carry discriminative structure. Denoising is a calibration tool, not a universal amplifier.
